quarterly_data.quarter: Intel press release: Intel Accelerates Open Infrastructure for the Agentic AI Era (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At the OCP Global Summit Intel shared new technical details on the Intel GPU D-series (formerly code-named Crescent Island), an inference GPU built on the Xe3P architecture that combines up to 480 GB of LPDDR5X memory, 1.5 TB/s of memory bandwidth and 1.3 petaflops of FP8 compute within a 350-watt power envelope in a standard PCIe, air-cooled form factor; it supports models with up to 300 billion parameters on a single card and more than one trillion parameters in an eight-GPU system. The Intel-branded PCIe card has 160GB LPDDR5x, and the design lets partners build ODM-branded cards with up to 480GB. Customer sampling is underway; Intel says it is collaborating with OEMs, ODMs, neoclouds, independent software vendors, appliance providers and AI-native companies to bring it into production. Anil Nanduri (VP, AI Products & GTM, Data Center Group): 'Inference is becoming the defining AI workload, and enterprises need infrastructure that delivers the right performance at the right cost.'
quarterly_data.figure: up to 480 GB LPDDR5X; 1.5 TB/s; 1.3 petaflops FP8; 350-watt; up to 300 billion parameters per card; Intel-branded card 160GB; customer sampling underway

quarterly_data.quarter: Intel press release: Intel Accelerates Open Infrastructure for the Agentic AI Era (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Intel showcased new Xeon-based rack designs developed with ecosystem partners, many built on the Open Compute Project's Open Rack v3 (ORv3) standard; select Xeon 6+ configurations scale beyond 46,000 cores per rack at 133.45 kW total rack power. Kevork Kechichian (EVP and GM, Data Center Group): 'Agentic AI is changing what customers need from their data centers. Success will depend not on any single component, but on open, heterogeneous infrastructure that brings together Xeon, purpose-built acceleration and interoperable software.'
quarterly_data.figure: Xeon 6+ beyond 46,000 cores per rack at 133.45 kW
